verdict.rationale: Maritime's billing docs describe a flat subscription with a set number of agents and flat-priced extras, explicitly with "No meters, no hourly rates." That is the opposite of per-second, usage-based compute billing. The only metering mentioned applies to LLM access, not sandbox compute, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can pay per second only for the compute a sandbox actually uses
